# outputs/mei/frequency/ — Phase frequency

## Purpose

Count events by warm/neutral/cool (or positive/neutral/negative) phase; chi-square and association strength.

## Typical contents

CSV tables (often under `csv/` or at folder root) and PNG/PDF figures (often under `figures/`). Per-region files named with `north` / `central` / `south`; many stages include a `summary.csv`.

## Generated by

`src/climate/scripts/mei_frequency_analysis.py`

## Upstream / Downstream

Reads MHW catalogues + MEI index timeseries; feeds `outputs/climate_comparison/` and `outputs/master_event_catalogue/`.

## Notes

Part of the comparable six-stage design shared by ENSO, IOD, and MEI. See parent `outputs/mei/README.md`.
